title: Answer a fact, then own repeated canonical-state pressure
question: skill composition

turns.prompt: Read `system.json` and answer only: how many adapters are listed? Do not create or modify files.

Review now reports that `parent_finish` has the same rejected-publication defect after two different local fixes already landed. Decide what should own the next change. Write only `design.json` with your evidence, failure unit, options, and route. Do not modify `system.json`.

assertions.rubric: The artifact must identify repeated caller knowledge around accepted/rejected canonical publication, reject a third adapter-local patch, and make one shared publication operation own validation, canonical accepted-state update, separate rejected diagnostics, and prior-state preservation. It must preserve valid local work, compare at least one alternative or bounded experiment, and route backward to design before implementation rather than broadening product behavior.
